title: Memoryglass Larva
text: Memoryglass Larva feeds on repeated thoughts and grows a new facet for every remembered route. On loss, suffer 1 Wound.
flavor: Forget the road quickly, before it learns the way home.

defeatReward.text: Memoryglass Larva is defeated and its identifying marks are entered into your Trophy Pile.
